Goal: pressure from level 1, win the mid-game, highest skill ceiling.
Judged from LoL wiki numbers (patch 26.22) run through a small
fight model, not from win rates. Win rates: tab 5 only (u.gg NA, 26.21).
Pulled 2026-11-07.

You choose the 3 s burst that fires it, then
spend 4 s of speed: chase, dodge or
re-space.

Three hits in 3 s, then 20 s down. One good
trade per wave.

Short 6 s cooldown: many small 2v2 trades,
each one a timing test.

Only pays if you land the first hit. Rewards
using W's range edge. Gold snowballs.

Up to double damage when Q or R lands from
max range.

Pays in long, even fights. Mostly automatic
once you are attacking.

A burn on Q, E and R. Kog's damage is in his
autos, not his spells.

Ranged gets 1 stack per attack: 12 attacks
to fill.
One hit on a low target every 35 s.

Two fast attacks, then 10 s down. Kog has no
attack reset to extend it.
A small heal. No damage since its rework.

• Stormraider's Surge is the pick for your goal. It
adds no damage, but when a diver slows you it lets you
land +72% more damage before you are caught (tab 3).
Nothing else is close: the best damage rune adds +10%.
• It fires from level 1: three W autos are already 25%
of a level 1 ADC's HP. In lane it is a free chase or a
free escape after every trade.
• Press the Attack is the lane-bully swap: +16% damage
in level 1 to 3 trades, every 6 s.
• Electrocute hits hardest early (+28%) but falls off
by mid-game and leaves Precision. Lane-only.
• Lethal Tempo is the most damage when nobody touches
you (+15% over 8 s), and the least reward for early
aggression: it never fills in a short trade.
• Skip Hail of Blades, Fleet and Conqueror on Kog.

Damage added = the same trade with the keystone vs with no keystone, against a typical enemy ADC (levels 1 to 6)
or a 2,400 HP diver (mid-game, tab 3). "Standing" = 8 s of free hitting on an enemy ADC. Sorted by goal: each column once, the slowed mid-game twice.
Skill ceiling is a judgment call (reason next to each). Everything else is computed.

W on, 3 autos (~2.7 s)
no keystone: 190 damage

Q, then 3 autos with W on
no keystone: 271 damage

Q, E, R and a full 8 s W
no keystone: 820 damage

• W at level 1 puts Kog at 630 range for 8 of every 17
s. That window is when you trade.
• Electrocute needs 3 hits inside 3 s. Level 1 Kog
attacks every 1.50 s, so the third auto lands at 3.01 s:
too late. The attack speed shard (1.37 s) fixes it. The
same shard is what makes every 3-hit rune work at level
1.
• Press the Attack procs on the 3rd auto, then has a 6 s
cooldown: one proc per trade, every trade.
• Lethal Tempo needs 6 attacks: about 8.2 s at level 1.
A short trade never reaches the bonus.
• Stormraider's fires in every one of these trades. At
level 1 it is +475 units of free movement over 4 s: more
than Kog's whole 130 unit W range bonus, three times
over.
• First Strike's gold is small in lane (~7 per level 3
trade). Its value is the 7% and the economy runes beside
it.

Model: Kog with the attack speed shard, W first, Q second, E third, W maxed; no items; target = an enemy ADC at the same level
(level 1: 640 HP, 26 armor). Q shreds resists when it lands. Comet assumes long-range casts (×1.5).
Not modelled: mana, misses, the enemy hitting back, minions. Values marked "a to b" on the wiki are taken as linear in level.
A diver chases you: who reaches who?

On-hit Kog, level 11, slowed 30%, vs a 390 move speed diver (2,400 HP).
Line = distance to the diver. Tick = an auto you land.
speed fires at 1.3 s (Q, E, 1 auto)
Damage landed before the diver reaches you
Within one 8 s W window, vs no keystone. Autos landed in brackets.

• Kog's mid-game is decided by how many W autos he
lands before someone reaches him. Damage runes
multiply each auto by a few %. Stormraider's adds
autos.
• Slowed 30%: no keystone lands 5 autos and is
caught at 3.1 s. Stormraider's lands 10 and is
caught at 6.4 s. Its 50% slow resist is half of
that.
• Open chase: Stormraider's still lands 3 more
autos (on-hit). Lethal Tempo's extra speed only
adds about one.
• It is back every ~13 s at level 11: every fight,
often twice.
• Limits: the diver here has no dash or knock-up.
A dash skips the chase and shrinks every
keystone's value, Stormraider's most. Against hard
engage, your flash and positioning matter more
than any rune.

Model: level 11, W rank 5, Q rank 3. On-hit = Blade of the Ruined King, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Berserker's Greaves. AP = Dusk and Dawn, Nashor's Tooth, Sorcerer's Shoes.
Item passives left out (every keystone gets them). Kog stands still only for his attack windup, then walks back.
Stormraider's fires once Kog has dealt 25% of the diver's max HP inside 3 s, from the real damage timeline.
Both builds. Any lane where you can trade inside W range.

• Stormraider's: every trade ends with a free chase or escape.
• Manaflow: Q, E and R stacks cost mana. Pressure every second
needs mana every second.
• Transcendence: 10 haste by level 8 takes W from 17 to 15.5 s, so
W is up 52% of the time instead of 47%. Takedowns refund 20% after
11.
• Scorch: extra lane damage on every Q and R poke. Gathering Storm
if you expect a long game.
• Alacrity + Coup de Grace: more autos per W, and the 8% that
finishes the chase.
• Shards: attack speed (level 1 breakpoint), move speed (stacks
with the surge), scaling HP.
On-hit build, a 2v2 lane decided at levels 2 to 3, an engage support.

• Press the Attack: +16% damage in every level 1 to 3 trade, every
6 s, and 8% on all follow-up damage.
• Presence of Mind: mana back on every trade.
• Alacrity + Coup de Grace: the Precision damage core.
• Transcendence + Scorch: W uptime and poke from the second tree.
• Shards: attack speed, adaptive, 65 HP (beats scaling HP until
about level 6).
• Cost: no speed. You win trades, but a dive catches you.
AP build, when you can reliably hit first from W range.

• First Strike: 7% true damage and gold, only when you hit first.
The most skill-tested keystone.
• Magical Footwear + Triple Tonic: free boots and elixirs. Your
gold goes straight into AP.
• Approach Velocity: 7.5% speed toward targets slowed by your E. A
small chase tool.
• Manaflow + Transcendence: mana and W uptime.
• Cost: no fight power after the first 3 s. Ranked third for your
goal.

Swaps: Tenacity and slow resist shard instead of scaling HP into heavy CC. Cut Down instead of Coup de Grace into tanks.
Gathering Storm instead of Scorch if the game will go long. Triumph instead of Alacrity if you keep dying right after kills.
Keystone pick rate by rank · u.gg, NA, Ranked Solo, patch 26.21
Context only. Win rate in brackets, with its rough 95% noise. Buckets overlap (Diamond+ holds Master+ holds Challenger).

• Stormraider's climbs with rank: 7% of games at
All ranks, 58% in NA Challenger. Lethal Tempo
falls from 74% to 26%.
• That matches the model: the best players picked
the rune that buys autos, not the one that adds
damage.
• No win-rate gap here is bigger than its noise.
Challenger is only 515 games, and a few one-tricks
play most of them.
• First Strike's high win rates sit on 20 to 40
games. Ignore them.
